template.gloss_en: This week's shows the theatre collected {M} raffle entries in total, last week it had collected {T} entries, and this week they are to be divided equally among {S} winners. How many raffle entries will each winner get this week?
template.notes: base_* drop last week's entry count; ex_sentence gives the entry box's door number; sem_sentence gives a neighbouring cinema's own raffle entries this week (different owner, excluded).
